title: CROSSFILTER NONE on a single-direction relationship makes the dimension filter ineffective
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], Product[Color] = "Blue", CROSSFILTER ( Sales[ProductKey], Product[ProductKey], NONE ) ) )

source.quote: Modifies the relationship cross filter direction (to one or both), or it disables filter propagation (none)
the cross-filter direction, which can be BOTH, ONEWAY, NONE
source.supports: the page's example with NONE returns the unfiltered count on every row

derivation: With the relationship disabled the filter Product[Color] = Blue does not reach Sales: the measure is the total, 100 + 40 + 20 + 50 + 200 + 30 + 100 = 540. With the relationship it would be 80.
